last_assistant_message: I ejected the Transcend drive (D:) safely. Windows accepted the request and no program blocked it, and D: no longer shows up on this PC, so you can unplug it now. Before ejecting I confirmed D: was the Transcend StoreJet (exFAT, 1863 GB). The only background process running was Claude Code's own logging, which writes to `~/.claude` on C:, not to D:. The usual right-click "Eject" did nothing the first time, so I used a different Windows command to remove it. **Next:** plug the drive into the new PC, open Claude Code there, and tell it: > 請讀取 `D:\Windows_Migration_Package\NEW_PC_RESTORE_RUNBOOK.md` 並依照文件執行。如果磁碟代號不是 D:，請先找出標籤為 Transcend 的磁碟。 From now on, don't change files on the old PC.
